newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada C$2.6 bln bond due 2002 yields 6.085 pct. [CORRECTED 22:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Canada C$2.6 bln bond due 2002 yields 6.085 pct. [CORRECTED 22:00 GMT]

text.p: The Government of Canada said its C$2.6 billion auction of 5.5 percent bonds due September 1, 2002 produced the following results:

The bonds will be dated and delivered on June 2. The outstanding debt of the issue now totals C$5.3 billion. Bids from primary dealers totalled C$5,557.9 million, including C$60.4 million non-competitive tenders at the average yield.
(Bank of Canada reissues prices due to incorrect data it issued at auction).
